```cypher
MATCH (p1:Plugin {name: 'Blackboard ILP Integration'})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(p2:Plugin {name: 'Open LMS Framework'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p2)-[:SUPPORTS]->(mr:MoodleRelease)
WITH p2, COLLECT(DISTINCT mr.release) AS supportedMoodleVersions
OPTIONAL MATCH (p3:Plugin)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(p2)
RETURN p2.component, supportedMoodleVersions, COLLECT(DISTINCT p3.name) AS dependentPlugins
LIMIT 100
```
